core.en: CORE IMAGE: a pea-like plant that ripens its pods underground.
core.cn: 核心意象：像豌豆一样的植物，把荚果结在土里。

branches.en: The seed in its pot is the naming sense.
branches.cn: 荚中之粒是最初命名的义项。

branches.en: The same word covers the whole crop plant.
branches.cn: 同一个词也指整株作物。

branches.en: Small cheap food becomes a unit for small money and minor matters.
branches.cn: 又小又便宜的食物成了小额钱与琐事的计量单位。

branches.en: Roasted peanuts and peanut butter are the prepared food sense.
branches.cn: 烤花生与花生酱是加工食品义项。

branches.en: The shell shape goes to comics, and cheap snacks go to cheap seats.
branches.cn: 荚的形状进入漫画，廉价零食进入廉价观众席。

intro.en: Peanut is an English compound rather than a root word: pea names a kind of seed and nut names the way it is eaten, and the two parts reappear across the food vocabulary.
intro.cn: peanut 是英语复合词而非词根词：pea 指明种子类别，nut 指明食用方式，两部分在食物词汇中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: The pea element comes from Latin pisum, which comes from Greek pison, while nut is a native English word with no Latin twin; the peanut itself has no Latin root word.
latinIntro.cn: pea 这一部分来自拉丁语 pisum（源自希腊语 pison），而 nut 是本土英语词、没有拉丁同源词；peanut 这种植物本身没有拉丁词根。

items.example: Latin pisum gives the English pea element.
items.exampleCN: 拉丁语 pisum 提供了英语 pea 这一部分。

items.example: Pea supplies the first part of peanut.
items.exampleCN: pea 是 peanut 的前半部分。

items.example: Nut supplies the second part of peanut.

definition_zh: 珍珠；珍珠色；（复数）首饰串珠；珍品；精华；（露珠、泪水等的）珠状物
definition_en: a hard smooth round bead formed inside an oyster shell, or anything prized as rare and beautiful
core_image: 蚌壳张开，内壁的软肉里嵌着一颗圆润发光的珠子
scene: 潜水员浮出水面，手里托着一只刚打开的贝壳，壳肉中卧着一颗小珠子。The diver surfaced with an opened shell in her palm, and inside its flesh lay a small pearl.
sceneCN: 这里 pearl 是「珍珠」（第 1 个义项：贝类体内形成的圆珠）；句意：潜水员浮出水面，手里托着一只刚打开的贝壳，壳肉中卧着一颗珍珠。

collocations.zh: 金玉良言（多带调侃意味）
明珠暗投；把好东西给不识货的人

derivatives.zh: 珍珠般的；珠光的，由 pearl 加形容词后缀 -y 构成
泛珠光的；带珍珠光泽的，pearl 加 -escent（呈现……的）构成
采珠人；采珠船，pearl 加表示施动者的后缀 -er 构成
做了珠光处理的，pearl 加 -ized（使呈现……）构成

senses.title: The bead grown inside a shell
senses.definition: a small hard round mass of nacre formed inside the shell of an oyster or other mollusc
senses.definitionCN: 在牡蛎或其他软体动物壳内形成的坚硬圆润的珍珠质小珠
senses.example: The necklace was made of farmed pearls.
senses.exampleCN: 这条项链是用养殖珍珠做的。
senses.why: The central sense names the object itself, a rounded growth produced by a living shell and valued for its lustre.
senses.whyCN: 核心义项直接指这个物体本身：由活体贝壳慢慢生成的圆珠，因光泽而珍贵。

senses.title: The colour of a pearl
senses.definition: a soft grey-white or pinkish-white colour with a faint sheen
senses.definitionCN: 柔和泛光的灰白或粉白色
senses.example: She chose a pearl grey coat for the wedding.
senses.exampleCN: 她为婚礼挑了一件珍珠灰的外套。
senses.why: The pearl surface colour is so recognisable that the noun becomes a colour word in fashion and paint.
senses.whyCN: 珍珠表面的颜色太有辨识度，于是这个名词在时装与涂料领域直接变成了颜色词。

senses.title: A string of pearls as jewellery
senses.definition: in the plural, a strand of pearls worn as an ornament, especially a necklace
senses.definitionCN: 复数形式指串成项链等饰物佩戴的珠串
senses.example: Her grandmother left her a string of pearls.
senses.exampleCN: 她的祖母留给她一串珍珠项链。
senses.why: Jewellery is worn in sets, so the plural has become a fixed way of naming the ornament rather than the beads.
senses.whyCN: 首饰成串佩戴，于是复数形式固定下来指整件饰物，而不是指一颗颗珠子。

senses.title: A thing or person of great worth
senses.definition: something or someone extremely rare and valuable, often found inside a plainer surround
senses.definitionCN: 极其罕见、珍贵的事物或人物，常被朴素的外层包着
senses.example: The old market is a pearl among the concrete blocks.
senses.exampleCN: 这座老市场在高楼丛林里如一颗明珠。
senses.why: A pearl forms inside a dull shell, so the word easily stands for hidden excellence wherever it is found.
senses.whyCN: 珍珠长在灰暗的贝壳里，所以这个词很容易用来指任何地方藏着的高价值之物。

senses.title: A drop shaped like a bead
senses.definition: a small round drop of liquid, such as dew on a leaf
senses.definitionCN: 一滴小而圆的水状物，如叶面上的露珠
senses.example: Pearls of dew hung on the spider web.
senses.exampleCN: 蛛网上挂着一颗颗露珠。
senses.why: One small round catch of light looks like a pearl, so the word lends its shape to drops of dew and tears.
senses.whyCN: 一小颗圆润的反光看起来就像珍珠，于是这个词把自己的形状借给了露珠和泪珠。

senses.title: Grit turned into a finished product
senses.definition: the idea that a painful irritant, patiently handled, produces something valuable
senses.definitionCN: 一种观念：痛苦的刺激若被耐心地包裹，最终会生出珍贵的东西
senses.example: Failure became a pearl after years of patient work.
senses.exampleCN: 经过多年耐心的打磨，失败反而成了珍宝。
senses.why: Because an oyster coats a grain of sand in layer after layer, the pearl became a compact image for growth out of hardship.
senses.whyCN: 牡蛎把一粒沙一层层包裹起来，于是珍珠成了一个凝练的意象——从磨难中长出的成长。

senses.title: To bead with drops
senses.definition: to be covered or adorned with small round drops or beads
senses.definitionCN: 被小圆水滴或珠子覆盖、点缀
senses.example: The leaves pearled with rain after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴雨过后，叶子挂满了雨珠。
senses.why: Like many object nouns, pearl turns into a verb describing the action and look of beadlike drops.
senses.whyCN: 和许多物品名词一样，pearl 也动词化，用来描述珠状水滴的出现方式和样子。

intro.en: Pearl comes through Old French perle from Latin perna, the leg-shaped clam that produced the finest pearls, later rebuilt under the influence of forms meaning round ring.
intro.cn: pearl 经由古法语 perle 来自拉丁语 perna，原指形状像腿、盛产佳珠的贝类，后来受表示「圆环」的形式影响而改写。

items.en: Latin perna names a large mussel and, by extension, the pearl found in it, a shift whose exact steps are uncertain.
items.cn: 拉丁语 perna 指一种大型贝类，并转指其中的珍珠；这一转移的具体过程来源不确定。

items.en: The form shifts towards perla, probably reshaped to match words for round rings, though the exact model for the change is uncertain.
items.cn: 词形向 perla 演变，一般认为是为了贴近表示圆环的词而被改写。

items.en: Perle enters French as the ordinary noun for pearl and for bead-like ornaments.
items.cn: perle 进入法语，成为指珍珠和珠状饰物的常用名词。

items.en: Perle appears in Middle English with both the jewel sense and the colour sense.
items.cn: perle 出现在中古英语中，兼有宝石义与颜色义。

items.en: The r is inserted by the sixteenth century, giving the modern spelling pearl.
items.cn: 十六世纪加入了字母 r，形成现代拼写 pearl。

items.en: Gem trade, diving, cultivation, and figurative lore all add senses such as cultured pearl and the pearl of wisdom.
items.cn: 珠宝贸易、采珠、养殖与比喻用法又增添了养殖珍珠、金玉良言等新义。

note.en: Pearl is a shell product, so its look-alikes are other gems and shell words, while its near meanings are other words for precious and beaded things.
note.cn: pearl 是贝类的产物，所以形近词是其他宝石与贝壳词汇，近义词是其他表示珍贵之物和珠状物的词。

entries.definitionCN: 珍珠层；构成珍珠的虹彩贝壳内壁，法语借词

entries.definition: an ornament set with precious stones
entries.definitionCN: 镶有宝石的饰物，也可比喻珍贵的人或物

entries.definitionCN: 中间穿孔的小圆珠，与珍珠同属珠串义场

normalIntro.en: Pearl is a short noun with a long chain of related words: pearly, pearlescent, pearler, all built on the same bead of shell.
normalIntro.cn: pearl 是个短名词，却有一条长长的词族：pearly、pearlescent、pearler 都长在同一颗贝壳珠上。

normal.en: The Latin source is perna, a leg-shaped mussel named for its shape before it named the jewel.
normal.cn: 拉丁语来源 perna 本指一种形似腿的贝类，是先有贝名再转指珍珠。

normal.en: Pearls is the fixed plural for a necklace or strand of beads.
normal.cn: pearls 是固定说法，指一串珍珠或珍珠项链。

normal.en: Pearl grey and pearl white name colours taken from the surface of the bead.
normal.cn: pearl grey 与 pearl white 都是从珠子表面取来的颜色名。

normal.en: Cultured pearl shows how cultivation reshaped the trade word.
normal.cn: cultured pearl 表明人工养殖重新塑造了这个行业词。

normal.en: The proverb cast pearls before swine warns against wasting beauty on those who cannot prize it.
normal.cn: 「明珠暗投」这句谚语提醒不要把美物浪费在不懂欣赏的人身上。

abstract.en: Picture a shell opening to reveal one glowing bead in soft flesh.
abstract.cn: 想象蚌壳打开，柔软的肉里露出一颗发光的珠子。

abstract.en: Picture grey-white silk catching the light like an oyster lining.
abstract.cn: 想象灰白丝绸反光，像牡蛎的内壁。

abstract.en: Picture the drawer of a grandmother with one old string still in its box.
abstract.cn: 想象祖母的抽屉里，一串旧珍珠还躺在盒子里。

examples.en: Divers once risked their lives for every pearl they found.
examples.cn: 从前潜水员为采到的每一颗珍珠冒生命危险。

examples.en: The morning grass was wet with pearls of dew.
examples.cn: 清晨的草地上挂满了露珠。

examples.en: The village library is a real pearl of the town.
examples.cn: 村里那座图书馆真是这座小镇的明珠。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「泼儿」——水珠泼成串，一颗颗像珍珠；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 perna（一种大贝类，后转指其珍珠）→ 通俗拉丁语 perla → 古法语 perle（珍珠）→ 中古英语 perle → 十六世纪加 r 成 pearl，核心义「由贝壳慢慢包出的一颗圆珠」。

sensesIntro.en: Pearl begins with the bead in the shell, then its colour, its jewel form, and the value it stands for, then finally the bead-like drop and the act of beading.
sensesIntro.cn: pearl 从壳里的珠子出发，衍生出颜色、首饰、比喻价值，最后走向珠状水滴与「布满水珠」的动作义。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a shining bead grown inside an oyster.
core.cn: 核心意象：在蚌壳内慢慢长出的一颗发光圆珠。

branches.en: The natural bead is the core sense.
branches.cn: 天然的珠子是核心义项。

branches.en: The bead surface gives a colour name.
branches.cn: 珠子表面给出一个颜色名。

branches.en: Strung beads become a piece of jewellery.
branches.cn: 串起的珠子成为一件首饰。

branches.en: Rarity and the grit story both turn the bead into a metaphor of worth.
branches.cn: 稀有性与沙粒成珠的故事都把珠子变成价值的比喻。

branches.en: The round drop and the verb both reuse the bead shape.
branches.cn: 圆水滴与动词义都复用了珠子的形状。

intro.en: Pearl is a borrowed noun with no productive prefix, so its word family is built mostly by adding English suffixes to the bare stem.
intro.cn: pearl 是借词，没有能产的词缀，词族主要靠在词干后加英语后缀构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin ancestor perna names a mussel rather than a pearl, and Old French perle carries the jewel sense into English.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语祖先 perna 指的是贝类而非珍珠本身，是古法语 perle 把珍珠义带入英语。
